name: Rei
source:
Main character of "Story 2 - School, a close friend and me"

[url=/c88248]Tsubame[/url]'s close friend. Rei is also one of the students agreeing to join the test of courage.

Later on in the story, [spoiler]the current Rei is revealed to have been dead for 10 years. She was murdered by [url=/c92081]Tsuguo[/url], for witnessing him killing another person. However, she can still befriend people in the real world, and so far, Tsubame is the only one who could understand her situation without laughing it off as a joke.[/spoiler]

A mischievous girl. She is jealous of Tsubame because she always wants to have a younger sister like [url=/c88249]You[/url].
